threat_model.threat_source: AI systems that attain 'the competence of the best researchers in an AI lab'
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: No intention is stated for the AI systems. The explicitly described harmful end state: 'recursive self-improvement (Good 1966)—the point at which humans are no longer required in the AI innovation loop—which would significantly complicate efforts for safety, regulation, and oversight'
threat_model.capability: Attaining 'the competence of the best researchers in an AI lab'
threat_model.access: Many instances of the AI are run in parallel on 'the same computational resources used to train an AI' (the AI is deployed/run on the lab's computational resources)
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: The scenario is explicitly conditional on capability attainment: 'If AI systems attain the competence of the best researchers in an AI lab'; the recursive self-improvement outcome is framed as a possibility rather than a certainty: 'In principle, this could lead to recursive self-improvement'
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Humans' required role 'in the AI innovation loop' (humans become 'no longer required' in it) and 'efforts for safety, regulation, and oversight' (which would be significantly complicated)

evidence.threat_source: If AI systems attain the competence of the best researchers in an AI lab
evidence.objective_or_harmful_outcome: In principle, this could lead to recursive self-improvement (Good 1966)—the point at which humans are no longer required in the AI innovation loop—which would significantly complicate efforts for safety, regulation, and oversight
evidence.capability: If AI systems attain the competence of the best researchers in an AI lab
evidence.access: the same computational resources used to train an AI may also be used to run many instances of that AI in parallel (Amodei 2024)
evidence.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: 'If AI systems attain the competence of the best researchers in an AI lab'; 'In principle, this could lead to recursive self-improvement'
evidence.target_or_asset_at_risk: the point at which humans are no longer required in the AI innovation loop—which would significantly complicate efforts for safety, regulation, and oversight
